'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[2024 Iran–Israel conflict]], [[Israel–Hezbollah conflict (2023–present)|Israel–Hezbollah clashes]]
**After Hezbollah shoots down a [[Elbit Hermes 450|Hermes 450]] drone, [[Israel]] conducts airstrikes on [[Hezbollah]] positions in [[Lebanon]]'s [[Beqaa Valley]], marking Israel's deepest incursion into Lebanon since the outbreak of hostilities. [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/israel-strikes-deeper-into-lebanon-hezbollah-downs-drone-2024-02-26/ (Reuters)]
*[[RED-Tabara]] militants launch an attack in Buringa, [[Bubanza Province]], [[Burundi]], killing nine people and injuring five others. The local headquarters of the ruling [[National Council for the Defense of Democracy – Forces for the Defense of Democracy|CNDD–FDD]] party is also set on fire. [https://actualite.cd/2024/02/26/attaque-meurtriere-de-red-tabara-au-burundi-pres-de-la-frontiere-de-la-rdc-au-moins-9 (Actualite)]

'''International relations'''
*[[Iran–Israel relations]]
**The [[Israeli Air Force]] announces the establishment of a new department dedicated to monitoring the [[Islamic Republic of Iran Armed Forces|Iranian Armed Forces]]. [https://m.jpost.com/israel-news/defense-news/article-788089 (''Jerusalem Post'')]
*[[Libya–Sudan relations]]
**[[Sudan]]ese military ruler [[Abdel Fattah al-Burhan]] meets with [[Libya]]n [[Government of National Unity (Libya)|Government of National Unity]] prime minister [[Abdul Hamid Dbeibeh]] in [[Tripoli, Libya|Tripoli]], Libya, to request help in the [[Sudanese civil war (2023–present)|war in Sudan]] due to the involvement of Libyan mercenaries. [https://sudanwarmonitor.com/p/al-burhan-seeks-libyan-help-in-sudan (Sudan War Monitor)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2024 Tuvaluan general election]]
**[[Feleti Teo]] is elected unopposed as the new [[Prime Minister of Tuvalu]]. Incumbent prime minister [[Kausea Natano]] lost his bid for re-election during January's general election. [https://www.rnz.co.nz/international/pacific-news/510174/feleti-teo-elected-new-tuvalu-pm-unopposed (RNZ)] [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/tuvalu-name-new-prime-minister-monday-2024-02-25/ (Reuters)]
*[[Enlargement of NATO]], [[Sweden–NATO relations]]
**The [[Hungary|Hungarian]] parliament approves [[Sweden]]'s accession into [[NATO]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-68405893 (BBC News)]
*[[2024 Hungarian presidential election]]
**The [[National Assembly (Hungary)|National Assembly]] selects [[Tamás Sulyok]] as the next [[President of Hungary]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/hungarian-parliament-elects-top-court-chief-new-president-2024-02-26/ (Reuters)]
*[[Prime Minister of the State of Palestine|Prime Minister of Palestine]] [[Mohammad Shtayyeh]] and the entirety of [[Shtayyeh Government|his government]] resign from office, amid public unpopularity and pressure from the [[United States]] government to reform during the [[Israel–Hamas war]].
